title: docs(adr-0126): list the six sys_metadata_activation.metadata_type values written on main
body:
Fixes #25252

**Tier H (`docs/adr/**`): the maintainer words and merges this by hand.** The seat proposes one wording; any other wording the maintainer prefers replaces it.

## What changes

`docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md` line 205, the `metadata_type` row of the `sys_metadata_activation` column table:

- before: `The artifact's registry type ('flow', 'permission', …)`
- after: `The artifact's registry type ('flow', 'action', 'position', 'permission', 'sharing_rule', 'webhook'; the runtime field description is the live list)`

The six values are the ones PR #25250 wrote into the runtime field description (`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts`, `metadata_type.description`). The card offered two shapes (list the six, or say the list is open and point at the field); this does both, so a seventh type later leaves the ADR pointing at the right place.

Docs only, no behaviour change: `skip-changeset`.
